id: title:arnohillen:hide secret dataclass fields from repr

review.posthog_relevance: Prevents credential leakage in tracebacks and logs by omitting secret fields from string representation.
review.reason: The observed changes add `repr=False` and `frozen=True` to credential fields in warehouse-source connector classes. This prevents sensitive credentials from appearing in debug output and potentially reduces accidental mutation, supporting a tier 1 score.
